verdict.rationale: Drata's docs say it connects tools and custom workflows to automate evidence collection, backed by integrations/Connections, Monitoring Tests and an Evidence Library with versions. Its open-source agent gathers device security settings (screensaver lock, antivirus, auto-updates) read-only. A community report confirms non-installed users automatically show as noncompliant in the dashboard. The evidence is mostly page titles and marketing lines, though. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of collection schedules or cadence, explicit timestamped artifact output replacing screenshots/CSVs, and independent hands-on corroboration of the evidence-collection quality.
